request_fields: Definition (task instruction) + instance input (sentence, tab, drug name); file also has 2 positive and 1 negative few-shot examples
notes: MedS-Bench (Wu et al., npj Digit Med 2024; arXiv 2408.12547) recasts the dataset as an instruction task. Henrychur/MedS-Bench holds the full test files ("the official benchmark"); Henrychur/MedS-Bench-SPLIT holds the subsample used for the paper's results. n_items counts the MedS-Bench file. The only ADE-derived MedS-Bench task is drug-dose extraction (Source "ade_corpus_v2"; instance ids prefixed task1451, i.e. taken from Super-NaturalInstructions). MedS-Ins has a separate ADE drug-extraction training task (task26), not downloaded. BRIDGE also lists the ADE corpus; MedS-Bench was used because it redistributes the items. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: instruction-style (MedS-Bench): the task Definition, a blank line, then the instance input (few-shot examples and outputs omitted)
rendering.template_source: none (instruction and input as released in the MedS-Bench task files)
